name: perl-ensembl-variation
description: This tool provides programmatic access to the Ensembl Variation database using an object-oriented Perl interface. Use when user asks to retrieve variant information, fetch genotypes or phenotypes, and calculate variant consequences on transcripts.
overview: The `perl-ensembl-variation` skill enables programmatic access to the Ensembl Variation database. It is designed for bioinformaticians needing to retrieve variant information, genotypes, phenotypes, and variant consequences (e.g., missense, stop-gained) across various species. This skill focuses on the object-oriented Perl interface which abstracts complex SQL joins into intuitive objects like `Variation`, `Allele`, and `TranscriptVariation`.
